<a name="Profile"></a>
## type [Profile](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L5>)

Profile names a signature profile \(Table 2.1\). The value is also used as the algorithm field of the release manifest.

```go
type Profile string
```

<a name="RSAPSS"></a>The three supported signature profiles.

```go
const (
    RSAPSS  Profile = "rsa-pss-sha256"
    ECDSA   Profile = "ecdsa-p256-sha256"
    Ed25519 Profile = "ed25519"
)
```

<a name="Parse"></a>
### func [Parse](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L16>)

```go
func Parse(s string) (Profile, bool)
```

Parse returns the Profile named s. The second result is false for any value that is not exactly one of the three supported profiles.

<a name="Profile.SignatureLen"></a>
### func \(Profile\) [SignatureLen](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L27>)

```go
func (p Profile) SignatureLen() int
```

SignatureLen returns the signature length in bytes: 384 for rsa\-pss\-sha256, 64 for ecdsa\-p256\-sha256 and ed25519, and 0 for an unknown profile.
